  Edge RTT = round trip to the Cloudflare edge over the telemetry socket (builds with M1.9); a link full of video makes its own edge RTT climb.
  One-way delay comes from the room clock offset and assumes both directions equal, so only a rise means something. The bottleneck line compares troubled samples (loss, freezes, encoder held back) with calm ones.

  A/V offset: positive = sound behind the picture; an estimate. [av] = difference of the two tracks' estimated playout clocks (s.av);
  [delay] = audio jitter buffer + playout + Web Audio output latency, minus video jitter buffer. Audio target = Settings' audio bitrate.
